exercise.name: Barbell Curl Press Extension
aliases: Barbell curl to press to triceps extension
Reverse-grip curl, press and overhead extension

reference.title: Barbell Curl Press Extension (male)
reference.listing: Video (title and product number from the listing URL; the page itself could not be read from this environment, so the movement follows the exercise name and standard coaching)
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

breathing.pattern: Breathe out during each effort (curl, press, extension up), breathe in during each lowering.
breathing.cadence: About 1 s per curl, press and extension, with controlled lowering

prescription.load: Barbell load is user-chosen and set by the weakest part (usually the overhead extension or the press). Leave about 2-3 reps in reserve (RPE 7-8).
prescription.progression: Add 1-2.5 kg when every part stays strict.

cues.text: Stand tall, feet hip width, underhand grip about shoulder width, bar at the thighs, elbows at the sides.
Curl the bar to the shoulders without letting the elbows drift forward or the body swing.
Press it overhead close to the face (chin back a little) to straight arms, palms still facing back.
Keep the upper arms beside the head and bend only the elbows, lowering the bar behind the head.
Straighten the elbows back to straight arms overhead.
Bring the bar back down to the shoulders.
Lower it under control to the thighs.

mistakes.fix: Lighter bar; elbows pinned at the sides.

mistakes.mistake: Elbows flaring wide in the extension
mistakes.fix: Keep the upper arms close to the head and pointing up.
Brace and squeeze the glutes; ribs down.
Lower behind the head only as far as you control; keep the upper arms still.

kinematics.setup: Underhand, 40 cm between the handle centres (shoulder joints 40.4 cm apart)
Arms hanging, elbow ≈6°, bar 1 cm off the thighs
kinematics.peak: Elbow ≈131° with the bar at the shoulders, elbows kept at the sides
kinematics.norm: Elbows stay at the sides through about 130-145 degrees of flexion (Coratella 2023)

kinematics.setup: From the shoulders, palms facing back
kinematics.peak: Arms straight overhead (elbow ≈15°), bar 54.1 cm above the shoulder joints
kinematics.norm: Arms close to vertical overhead (clinical opinion)

kinematics.setup: Upper arms beside the head, 6° forward
kinematics.peak: Elbow ≈121° with the bar behind the head (3 cm or more from the head / neck; closest 1.38 cm)
kinematics.norm: Elbows bend about 90-120 degrees with the upper arms up; overhead extension trains the triceps at long length (overhead training study 2022)

kinematics.peak: Curl 1 s, press 1.2 s, extension 1.1 s down and 0.9 s up, lower 1.1 s, uncurl 1.1 s

sources.title: GymVisual, Barbell Curl Press Extension (male), video (movement reference only)
Coratella et al. 2023, biceps brachii and brachioradialis excitation in biceps curl exercise: different handgrips, different synergy (Sports 11(3):64; PMC10054060)

Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position (Eur J Sport Sci 2022, DOI 10.1080/17461391.2022.2100279; PubMed 35819335; 21 adults, 12 weeks, cable)

cautions: Use a light bar: the overhead extension is the weak link and the bar travels behind the head.
Stop the extension well clear of the head and neck.
Do not arch the lower back as the bar goes overhead.
Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Elbow discomfort in the extension: shorter range or a narrower grip.
Shoulder discomfort overhead: drop the press and extension, keep the curl.
regressions: The three parts as separate sets.
progressions: Pause at the bottom of the extension.

muscleNotes.biceps_r: Flex the elbows in the curl with the forearms supinated (Coratella 2023).
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Flex the elbows in the curl with the forearms supinated (Coratella 2023).
muscleNotes.triceps_r: Lock out the press and do the overhead extension; the overhead position works them at long length (overhead training study 2022; Maeo).
muscleNotes.triceps_l: Lock out the press and do the overhead extension; the overhead position works them at long length (overhead training study 2022; Maeo).
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_r: Help flex the elbow and hold the underhand grip.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_l: Help flex the elbow and hold the underhand grip.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Rotate the shoulder blades up for the overhead work.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Rotate the shoulder blades up for the overhead work.
muscleNotes.serratus_r: Rotates the shoulder blades up and holds them on the ribs.
muscleNotes.serratus_l: Rotates the shoulder blades up and holds them on the ribs.
muscleNotes.core: Stops the lower back arching as the bar goes overhead.
muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Squeeze to keep the pelvis tucked under the overhead bar.
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Squeeze to keep the pelvis tucked under the overhead bar.
